name: Claim My Land
landing_text: $(bold)Claim My Land$() started out as a simple land claim mod, known as $(bold)Protect It!$() It has been modified and updated to be a more advanced mod, but hopefully retains its simplicity. Unlike other land claim mods, there are no restrictions to adhering to a chunk-based sizing system. A claim ( known as a Parcel ) can be any size and can be placed anywhere.$(br2)Mod ID: claimmyland
